About us
HRS Trailers is a well-established Australian trailer and truck body manufacturer based in Penrith, NSW. We design and manufacture high-quality transport solutions for a wide range of industries, with a strong reputation for reliability, workmanship, and innovation.
Due to continued growth, we are looking for motivated people to join our friendly, family-oriented team. We have opportunities for experienced tradespeople as well as Trades Assistants who are keen to develop their skills in the heavy vehicle manufacturing industry.

Positions Available
	• Boilermakers / Welders
	• Vehicle Body Builders
	• Truck & Trailer Fitters
	• Trades Assistants (TA)

About You
We are looking for people who have:
	• Experience with MIG welding in a workshop environment
	• Ability to read and work from engineering drawings (preferred)
	• Good attention to detail and pride in quality workmanship
	• Ability to work independently and as part of a team
	• Positive attitude and strong work ethic

Role-specific requirements:
Boilermaker / Welder
	• Trade qualified (or equivalent industry experience)
	• Minimum 5 years' experience preferred
	• Experience working with structural steel and heavy fabrication
Vehicle Body Builder
	• Experience building truck bodies and/or trailers
Fitter
	• At least 1 year of experience in the truck and trailer industry
Trades Assistant
	• Keen to learn and develop into a qualified Boilermaker, Welder or Fitter
	• Previous workshop experience is advantageous but not essential

Your Responsibilities
Depending on your role, you will be involved in the manufacture and assembly of:
	• Tipper Trailers
	• Dog Trailers
	• Tag Trailers
	• Float Trailers
	• Truck Bodies

You will:
	• Manufacture and assemble components from engineering drawings
	• Perform fabrication, welding, fitting and assembly tasks
	• Work safely while maintaining high quality standards

What We Offer
	• Competitive above-award pay rates (based on experience)
	• Overtime available
	• Friendly and supportive team environment
	• Ongoing training and career development
	• Opportunity to grow with an expanding Australian manufacturer
	• Salary: $73,000 -$80,000 Per Year

Thai Steel Fabrications located in Sumner QLD is a family-owned and operated business with over 30 years of experience, we have been proudly servicing businesses Australia-wide since 1994. Our expertise lies in the fabrication and installation of top-notch concrete mixers that are used by major concreting companies throughout the country.

Thai Steel Fabrications is seeking qualified Welders to join our professional team. We are looking for trustworthy individuals with integrity who will bring a positive can-do attitude to the position and to the team.

The role includes but is not limited to:
Read and interpret project plans, engineering drawings, blueprints and other written instructions and diagrams to perform task at hand
Perform fabrication and repair works on various metal structures and components according to engineering drawings, specifications, and blueprints
Work with variety of materials, including steel, aluminium, and other alloys
Weld small and large components such as copper plumbing, beams, and pipelines
Perform appropriate type of weld - base on project needs and specifications
Weld components in flat, vertical, and overhead positions
Ensure fabrication and repairs are carried out using the proper safety guidelines to ensure rework jobs do not occur
Use a range of hand and power tools, including grinders, drills, and cutting tools
Conduct quality checks on completed work to ensure it meets standard specifications
Monitor machinery for appropriate usage and temperature
Follow and enforce strict safety regulations such as wearing heat-resistant gloves, protective masks, and safety shoes to prevent accidents and injuries in the workplace.

To be considered for this role, you must have the following:
Trade certificate in Engineering Fabrication or Equivalent
Proficient in performing all welding, gouging, cutting or other duties
Post trade experience in the same field
Proactive attitude with the desire to work reliably as part of an outstanding team to deliver excellence for our clients
Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings, specifications, and blueprints
Experience working with a variety of materials, including steel, aluminum, and other alloys
Familiarity with a range of hand and power tools, including grinders, drills, and cutting tools
Strong attention to detail and the ability to conduct quality checks on completed work
Ability to work independently or as part of a team to complete assigned tasks
Knowledge of safety procedures and regulations to prevent accidents and injuries in the workplace
Strong communication and reporting skills
Self-motivated, organised, punctual and reliable
Must have great work ethics

If you meet the above criteria and would like to be considered for this position, please apply now!
Salary: Between $75,000 and $80,000 per annum + Super

Interested in a new Senior Network Engineer opportunity?   
  Your new company  
 By joining the Queensland Government, you are joining a dynamic team committed to shaping and elevating Queensland's workforce to meet the evolving needs of our industries, ensuring prosperity and agility in our economic landscape. 
   
  Your new role   
 As a Senior Network Specialist within the Public Safety Network Centre (PSNMC) Deployment team, you will be crucial in the support of deploying network capabilities for the supported agencies. You will be responsible for configuring hardware for deployment, commission hardware for sites and the implementation of the project deliverables. 
   
  Key Responsibilities   
 As the Senior Network Specialist, you will: 
 
 
 Build and configure Cisco routers according to network specifications for operation within an SR-MPLS framework. 
 
 
 Update inventory and configuration records to reflect build of the devices. 
 
 
 Develop change documentation for subsequent approval by client agencies. 
 
 
 Commission routers and network monitoring hardware within the PSN remotely in conjunction with contracted installers on site. 
 
 
 Update inventory and configuration records to reflect commissioning of the new devices and removal of the previous devices. 
 
 
 Conduct data integrity checks for hardware and PSN sites. 
 
 
 Conduct handovers of hardware to the Operations team for ongoing support and maintenance. 
 
 
 Operate within PSNMC technical framework for Change, Release, Incident and Problem Management processes. 
 
 
   What you'll need to succeed  
 To thrive in this role, you will need to demonstrate the following: 
 
 
 Demonstrated experience with SR-MPLS networks. 
 
 
 Demonstrated understanding of overlay and underlay layer 3 routing protocols including MP-BGP and OSPF and experience in environments with hundreds of individual peering's using IPv4 and IPv6. 
 
 
 Demonstrated understanding of end to end Quality of Service (QoS) deployment regime incorporating: o MPLS QoS 
 
 
 o Layer 3 QoS in a non-MPLS environment 
 o Layer 2 QoS in a non-MPLS environment 
 
 
 Familiarity with Cisco routers. 
 
 
 Familiarity with Network Virtualisation Technologies e.g. MPLS VPNs including: VRFs, VPLS, EVPN, VRF-lite and VXLAN. 
 
 
 Demonstrated experience with wireless and radio networks, such as controller, access point, WLAN, 4/5G LTE design and deployment using Cisco. 
 
 
 Demonstrated experience managing authentication technologies such as TACACS, Radius, OTP, Active Directory, SAML / SSO and OAuth. 
 
 
 Demonstrated experience with remote access and encryption technologies for site to site (e.g. IPSEC VPNs, Cisco DMVPN) and client to site (e.g. SSL VPN) Always On VPN, and MACsec. 
 
 
 Demonstrated experience analysing packet captures and logs to determine application and network issues using tcpdump, Wireshark, NetScout and Splunk tools. 
 
 
 Demonstrated experience with carrier core, aggregation, access interconnect such as PNI, NNI and subscriber access. Retail and wholesale telecommunications service mapping and hand-off. 
 
 
     
  What you'll get in return  
 
 By joining the Queensland Government, you are joining a dynamic team committed to shaping and elevating Queensland's workforce to meet the evolving needs of our industries, ensuring prosperity and agility in our economic landscape. 
 We connect individuals with quality training and skills development, opening doors to new opportunities and economic participation. 
 A career with the department means making a real difference - join us in building a skilled, adaptable, and vibrant workforce for Queensland. 
 
  What you need to do now  
 If you're interested in this role, click 'APPLY NOW' to forward an up-to-date copy of your CV, or call now (Tejasva Awasthi - +61 (07) 3243 3060/ Tejasva.Awasthi@hays.com.au) 
 If this job isn't quite right for you, but you are looking for a new position, please contact us for a confidential discussion about your career. 
    Please  click here  to apply.
